prompt: I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.

timestamps.source: The outer benchmark recorder wrote startedAt immediately before launching Codex and finishedAt immediately after Codex exited following turn.completed. The harness emitted no time-to-first-token or model-latency fields.

usage.source: Final turn.completed usage event in validation/openai-gpt-5-6-sol-xhigh-codex-20260813.session.jsonl. totalTokens is inputTokens plus outputTokens; cached input and reasoning output are subsets.

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex exec --json --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-xhigh-YloUI3/workspace --sandbox danger-full-access --model gpt-5.6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh --output-last-message /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-record-gpt-5-6-sol-xhigh-cKfoow/final-response.md [exact benchmark prompt passed as argv]

dataSource.notes: The final self-contained HTML embeds the retrieved FRED daily closing-price CSV. It contains 2,608 dated rows including blank non-trading-day observations and loads 2,512 valid numeric observations after filtering blanks. The dashboard and README disclose that SP500 is a price index excluding dividends. No runtime data fetch is required.

commands.name: fresh-workspace
commands.command: pwd and rg --files in the configured benchmark workspace

commands.name: official-source-research
commands.command: Codex web search for the official FRED SP500 series, FRED API documentation, and official S&P 500 overview
commands.result: Selected FRED SP500 as the daily closing-price source and S&P Dow Jones Indices as the index-methodology source.

commands.name: fred-snapshot-retrieval
commands.result: Retrieved the FRED CSV from 2016-08-15 through 2026-08-12 and embedded it in the standalone HTML.

commands.name: initial-browser-render
commands.command: Google Chrome headless DOM dump of file:///tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-xhigh-YloUI3/workspace/index.html
commands.result: The first render marked the dashboard ready but exposed NaN forecast and validation values because blank holiday rows were parsed as zero. The model diagnosed and repaired this before completion.

commands.name: corrected-browser-render
commands.command: Google Chrome headless DOM dump with dashboard-ready and forecast/validation output assertions
commands.result: Dashboard ready; current level 7,749; median endpoint 8,484; median endpoint error 5.6%; direction rate 89%; interval coverage 100%; 18 historical starts.

commands.name: automated-self-test
commands.command: Google Chrome headless DOM dump of index.html?selftest=1
commands.result: data-dashboard-ready=true and data-selftest=passed. The alternate state showed a 252-session horizon, 95% confidence, finite 9,247 median endpoint, and finite model specifications.

commands.name: desktop-screenshot
commands.result: Created a 1440x1400 RGB PNG with 187,187 bytes.

commands.name: desktop-interaction-validation
commands.command: Chrome DevTools Protocol control, interval, validation, reset, and canvas assertions
commands.result: Passed. Default state loaded 2,512 observations with 8,484.2588 median, 7,123.0186 lower bound, 10,105.6380 upper bound, 18 validation starts, 5.5695% median error, 88.8889% direction rate, 100% coverage, and a 595x386 canvas. Changing to 252 sessions, 95% confidence, and trend drift produced a 9,246.7657 median; reset restored 126 sessions, 90%, and historical drift.

commands.name: mobile-render-and-layout
commands.command: Google Chrome 390x1000 screenshot plus Chrome DevTools Protocol mobile layout assertions
commands.result: Created a 390x1000 RGB screenshot. At a 390px emulated viewport, document and body widths were both 390px, the forecast card was 362px, the canvas was 340px, and the dashboard-ready flag was true.

commands.name: final-wording-self-test
commands.command: Google Chrome headless self-test after validation-overlap disclosure cleanup
commands.result: data-dashboard-ready=true and data-selftest=passed; the validation note states that historical starts are spaced, no future data is used in estimation, and some test windows overlap.

warnings: The first attempt to inject the retrieved CSV with apply_patch failed hunk verification; the model recovered and embedded the complete data before validation.

Codex reported a non-fatal file-watcher warning while exiting.
